verification.method: scripts/verify/malaysia.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank, share, growth, density, land area; roughly six times 1950; sixth in South-Eastern Asia
Natural increase and net migration 2026 (about 40% of growth); net outflow every year 1952–1979, inflow since; 2006 record inflow; males per 100 females
Births peak 1996 and now; fertility 1957 high, under 2.1 since 2013
Deaths above births from 2060, peak 2072, 2100 between today and the peak; median age 2026/2050; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 66 of 66 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
verification.result: All figures match. Comparisons name the size group used (countries over 1, 5 or 50 million) so small territories do not change the ranking. The page explains no causes the UN data do not show. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
